lan.title: HocusPocus LAN access
lan.unreachable: HocusPocus could not reach its local server.
lan.invalidToken: That LAN access token is not valid.
lan.hint: Enter the session token shown in the Pinokio launch terminal. You only need to do this once per browser session.
lan.httpWarning: This LAN page is using unencrypted HTTP. Only enter the token on a network you trust.

oom.title: Out of VRAM
oom.directorFailedClip: Director pipeline failed on clip {{current}} of {{total}}.
oom.applied: VRAM headroom lowered to {{value}} — try the generation again
oom.lowerBody: Lower VRAM headroom from {{current}} to {{suggested}} to reserve more memory for generation spikes (long videos, VAE decode). About ~5% slower per generation.
oom.afterApply: After applying, re-run the generation — it'll use the new headroom on next model load.
oom.atFloor: VRAM headroom is already at {{value}} (the safe minimum). Lowering it further won't help. Try a smaller model variant (e.g. INT8 or GGUF), reduce resolution, or shorten video length.

download.interrupted: A download was interrupted — re-run to finish it
download.slow: Download is slow — waiting for retry
download.title: Downloading model files
download.noProgress: No progress for {{seconds}}s. The download will resume from where it left off as soon as the connection recovers — no action needed from you.
